title: California Auto Insurance Requirements
text: California requires all drivers to carry minimum liability insurance coverage. The minimum requirements are 15000 for bodily injury per person, 30000 for bodily injury per accident, and 5000 for property damage. This is known as 15/30/5 coverage. SR-22 is required for certain violations.
